frontmatter.lede: Every machine is tested before dispatch with calibrated measuring equipment and certified test weights.

media.brief: Machine under load on the test stand, certified weights and instrumentation visible. 2000×1125.
Before and after of the same machine at a matched angle. 1600×900.

steps.title: Condition assessment
steps.body: Strip and inspect drum, shaft, bearings, brakes, hydraulics, structure (NDT) and control system obsolescence. Written report and recommendation.

steps.title: Upgrade
steps.body: Control system, instrumentation, brake, hydraulic circuit, safety systems or capacity, carried out during the rebuild.

steps.title: Test
steps.body: Static proof load, dynamic functional load, brake holding, render and speed tests to 150 Te, as for a new machine.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.body: Quality Record Book and User and Maintenance Manuals reissued to the as-rebuilt condition.

media.brief: Before and after of the same machine at a matched angle. 1600×900.
The traction winch as it arrived from the vessel, before any work. Wide three-quarter view on the shop floor, corrosion and service wear visible. 1600×900.
The same winch after rebuild, photographed from the identical position, lens and lighting as IMG-16a. 1600×900.

frontmatter.lede: Your design, built, tested and certified in our factory. Four cumulative tiers under one contract, one project file and one point of contact. The design and IP remain yours at every tier.

media.brief: Factory walk-through, machines part-built on the shop floor, client branding absent. 1600×900.

cards.title: Tier 1: structural fabrication
cards.blurb: Welded structures to your drawings; EN ISO 3834 discipline; NDT to ISO 9712 level 2; 100% traceability on main structural welds; machining to 12 m and 10 t in one setup.

cards.title: Tier 2: mechanical assembly
cards.blurb: Drums, shafts, bearings, gearboxes, brakes, sheaves, level wind; torqued, aligned and rotation checked.

cards.title: Tier 3: hydraulic and electrical build
cards.blurb: Power units, pipework flushed to class, valve blocks, panels, cabling and instrumentation.

cards.title: Tier 4: automation, test and commissioning
cards.blurb: PLC and HMI loading, interlock proving, load test to 150 Te under class witness, certification dossier, vessel commissioning.

frontmatter.lede: LARS bodies, stern and side frames, A-frames, drums, gantries, sea-fastenings and sub-assemblies, welded to your drawings and procedures. Large-dimension machining up to 12 m and 10 t in a single setup.

media.brief: Welder at work, arc light, correct PPE, honest not staged. 1600×900.

frontmatter.lede: Tier 1 plus drums and shafts, bearings, gearboxes, brakes, sheaves, level wind, guards and covers. Fasteners to your torque specification; alignment and rotation checked.

media.brief: Drum and shaft being lowered into bearings, hoist in frame. 1600×900.

frontmatter.lede: Tier 2 plus power units, hydraulic pipework and hose routing, valve blocks and manifolds, flushing to a defined cleanliness class, control panels, cabling, glanding and terminations, sensors and instrumentation.

media.brief: Hydraulic pipework and manifolds, clean and ordered. 1600×900.

frontmatter.lede: Tier 3 plus PLC and HMI software loading and configuration, function and interlock proving, and testing on our stands to 150 Te. Class witness where required. Commissioning and operator familiarisation on site or on the vessel.

media.brief: HMI live during function testing, engineer at the console. 1600×900.

steps.title: Drum and shaft condition
steps.body: Sound drum and shaft generally favour refurbishment. Significant wear or cracking favours replacement.

steps.title: Brakes and hydraulics
steps.body: Both are renewable. Long-term hydraulic contamination indicates wider wear.

steps.title: Capability
steps.body: Additional depth, load or control can often be achieved by upgrade during the rebuild.

steps.title: Spares availability
steps.body: Obsolete control systems are the most common cost driver; replacement controls can be included in the rebuild.

steps.title: Class status
steps.body: Timing the rebuild with a renewal survey reduces cost and downtime.

steps.title: Required service life
steps.body: Match the rebuild to the vessel's remaining life.
